''See also: [[Mekendi Maxeus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Mekendi Maxeus was a prominent figure serving as the Head of the [[Magisters]]' [[Guild]]. A highly respected instructor at the [[Imperial]] Academy in the Capital, he was known for his [[Heartlander]] heritage and a distinctive appearance characterized by a black [[The mask|mask]] that obscured his facial expressions. He often carried a staff made of charred wood, which could produce a luminous flame. Maxeus was recognized as a powerful [[Magister]] possessing highly controlled and concentrated [[Intent]], making him a formidable presence. He was also an orator with a resonant voice and was described as a gentlemanly figure, though he remained somewhat enigmatic to others. His strategic mind was evident in his calculated political maneuvers, such as the assassination of [[Alagaeus]], the [[Regent of the East]], which he used to destabilize regional power and further his own objectives. Despite his competence and confidence in managing complex political crises, Maxeus was eventually killed by a [[Consultant]] [[Soulbound]] and her partner. Following his death, one of his properties was destroyed, and the [[Magisters]]' [[Guild]] remained without a new appointed leader for some time.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Mekendi Maxeus possesses [[Heartlander]] skin and wears a painted black [[The mask|mask]]. This individual also carries an [[ash-gray staff]] made of charred wood.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a [[Magister]], Maxeus is motivated by the desire to see a united Empire. A trained orator, they are skilled at tailoring declarations for various audiences.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Mekendi Maxeus was killed by a [[Consultant]] [[Soulbound]] and her partner. This individual is an enigma to [[Nathanael Bareius|Bareius]], while [[Shera]] is identified as the person who attacked Maxeus.}}
